newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar to supply equipment in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar to supply equipment in Russia.

text.p: Caterpillar Overseas S.A., a unit of Caterpillar Inc, said Wednesday it sold 40 pieces of equipment and spare parts worth $36.5 million to Russia's largest diamond producer.
Caterpillar will supply a fleet of mining trucks, track-type tractors and excavators along with spare parts for use by Almazy Rossii-Sakha, in Eastern Siberia.
Shipments are expected to begin during the first quarter of 1997. Caterpillar said the products will be manufactured at its plants in Aurora, Decatur and East Peoria, Ill.
Almazy Rossii-Sakha already owns more than 70 pieces of Caterpillar equipment.
